action.body: The driver is at the pedestrian gate with DL-003. Can you admit them now using the intercom, or come to the gate? Please do not share a permanent code.

later_events.body: I can see the courier on the intercom. I will release the gate and meet them in the lobby now.
Gate access was granted from inside. Elva Kesh met me in the lobby and received DL-003 at 09:48 UTC; the matching handover scan is complete.
